axisBearing.meaning: bearing of the frame +x axis (toward the east front), degrees clockwise from north

source.outline: OpenStreetMap way 613801136 (building=temple, ruins=yes, wikidata Q596988) via the Overpass API; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL

outlineSize.note: close to the lowest step (30.5 x 15.5 m), so its centroid is taken as the stylobate centre

source.stylobateElevation: derived: Copernicus GLO-30 (bicubic) at the OSM temple centroid (179.14 m) minus 1.0 m; no primary absolute level found in Furtwaengler 1906 text or the research briefs (Wikipedia: hill about 160 m, secondary)
source.crossCheck: expected about 37.754 N, 23.533 E and an east-facing front: met. The OSM archaeological-site polygon (way 273253076) has its long edge at grid bearing 66.5 deg, agreeing with the temple outline. The 1911 sanctuary plan's north arrow is schematic: it implies a near due-east axis (about 20 deg off), so the plan was registered to the temple only and its arrow is not used.

uncertainty.note: OSM outlines are traced from imagery (metres); DSM at 30 m posting with tree/ruin bias (metres)

terraceVsDem.note: DEM minus the ancient terrace level (foot of the lowest step) along the 1911-plan wall centre lines; positive = DEM above the terrace
